### Keeping the Sabbath
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/keeping-sabbath
Passage: Jeremiah 17:19-27
Points:
- Jeremiah proclaimed God's Sabbath command at the city gates, giving Judah a choice between blessing and ruin.
- Disregarding the Sabbath demonstrated a deeper spiritual rupture, violating a command rooted in creation itself.
- Resuming Sabbath obedience would serve as a clear sign of Judah's repentance and restoration.
- Honoring the Lord's Day is intended to sustain a vital personal relationship with the Creator, not promote empty ritual.
- God desires sincere devotion of the heart rather than disobedient formalism.
